launcher.label: Fullscreen Mode

settings.label: Ignore built-in layout fixes
settings.note: Skips the hand-made placements built into the mod and uses only the automatic layout (plus the placements you saved in the layout editor).

settings.label: Layout editor
settings.note: Shows the Layout button in the game. Tap an element to pick it, set how it is placed and nudge it, then Save.

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: InputManager.Update, second instruction (once a frame, in every scene): the callback sets the game's resolution to the screen's aspect ratio through UnityEngine.Screen.SetResolution, which the Switch build's GameScreen.SetResolution (0x1F3EBD0, a bare ret) never calls
